Yen Surges on Suspected Japanese Market Intervention

The Japanese yen surged against the US dollar, with analysts and news reports indicating official intervention to support the currency. The yen's sharp rise followed a Reuters photo showing a "to do" list with a "$5-10 billion Japanese Yen purchase" noted. Gold prices also held gains due to the dollar's decline. The intervention occurred ahead of a Bank of Japan policy decision, after which the yen weakened.
